hooks.command: file=$(cat | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))'); case "$file" in *.js) node --check "$file" ;; esac
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && status=0; for f in $(find src -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || status=1; done; exit $status
